d:
Grand Theft Auto VI is taking the world by storm. The video game is expected to earn billions for Rockstar Games. Firstpost talks to Brian Baglow, one of the writers for the original GTA, about the journey of the GTA franchise. Utsav Parekh discusses the cultural, financial and technological impact GTA 6 is expected to have. Catch the conversation on Firstpost PoV.
